name: Armored Claws
description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). On a critical hit, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or have one object it is carrying wrested from its grasp and flung up to 30 ft. away.
